name: Vouchery
description: Vouchery is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline the creation, management, and optimization of promotional campaigns and vouchers. It offers businesses the tools to enhance customer engagement and drive sales through targeted promotions.

events.d: Triggered when a new voucher is created.
Pass redemption data and get discount data back to your app.
Find a voucher by campaign metadata (purpose, team, channel, medium) or customer ID. Optionally select fields.
List customers in your Vouchery project, filter by identifier or email, and choose response fields.
Retrieve redemptions, optionally filtering by code and pagination (page, per_page).
List invalid redemptions in your Vouchery project, optionally filtered by voucher code.
Retrieve cancelled redemptions, filter by code and paginate results.
Get a list of project integrations.
Get a list of all subscriptions for the project.
Get users in a project; supports page, per_page, and optional selected response fields.
